skills.name: Servant of Holy Cities
skills.desc:
Whenever this commander's troop is hit with a basic attack, it has a {s1}% chance to gain a damage-absorbing Mighty Shield for {p3} seconds (Damage Factor {p2}). At the same time, apply the following:
- If the troop has less than {p5} stacks of Reign: Deal smite damage to the target troop (Damage Factor {p4}).
- If the troop has {p5} or more stacks of Reign: Take {s6}% less damage for {p7} turn and deal smite damage to up to 3 enemy troops in a fan after {p7} turn (Damage Factor {p8}; every additional target reduces the damage to each target by 15%).
This effect can trigger once every {p10} seconds.
skills.brief:
Selim I's troop has a chance to gain a Mighty Shield whenever it is hit with a basic attack.
Based on the stacks of Reign it has, Selim I's troop will either deal smite damage to the target troop, or gain a damage reduction bonus before dealing smite damage to multiple enemy troops in a fan.

skills.name: Heavy Is the Crown
skills.desc:
After dealing smite damage, this commander's troop has a {s1}% chance to deal {s4}% more smite damage and increase the hit troop's normal damage taken by {s3}% for {p2} seconds.
Whenever this commander's troop is hit with a basic attack when it has a shield, its attacker loses {s5}% Attack for {p6} seconds. This effect can trigger up to {p7} times per turn, and only once by the same target per turn.
skills.brief:
After dealing smite damage, Selim I's troop has a chance to gain a bonus to smite damage and increase the hit troop's normal damage received.
Whenever Selim I's troop is hit by a basic attack when it has a shield, it reduces its attacker's Attack.

skills.name: Reign of the Barmakids
skills.desc:
Up to {p2} nearby allied or friendly troops (including this commander's troop) gain {s4}% Health for {p3} seconds.
The target troop loses {s6}% Defense for {p5} seconds.
skills.brief: For a period of time, nearby allied or friendly troops gain Health while the enemy troop loses Defense.

skills.desc: This commander's troop gains {s1}% Gathering Speed when gathering Gold and {s2}% Gathering Speed when gathering Wood, Stone, or Food.

words.1:
The maximum units a commander can have in their troop.
(The Unit Capacity of your rallied armies is based on your Castle level)
words.2: Units who cannot take part in battle right now, but will instantly get healed as soon as they return to your city. They can also be brought back into battle if they are healed by a commander's skills.
words.4: All units are one of four types: infantry, archers, cavalry, or siege units. Unit tiers do not affect their classification.
words.5: Silenced troops cannot use active skills.
words.6: Includes effects such as Silence, Disarm, and Heal Immune.
words.7: Slow debuffs are effects that reduce the target troop's March Speed.
words.8: The Poison effect is inflicted by Tomyris's "Massagetae's Counterattack" skill, as well as Prime Hermann's "Mandrake Root" and "Forest of Fallen Eagles" skills.
words.9: The Exhaustion effect is inflicted by Chandragupta Maurya's "Arthashastra" skill.
words.10: The Burn effect is inflicted by Takeda Shingen's "Fierce as the Fire" skill and Subutai's "Hound of Temujin" skill.
words.11: Normal debuffs include effects that reduce the target troop's Attack, Defense, Health, or healing received.
words.12: Disables the normal attacks of the target troop(s).
words.13: The target troop's slightly wounded units cannot be healed.
words.14: Applies to debuffs that reduce all damage dealt, but not specific types of damage (e.g. normal damage debuffs).
words.15: Includes the gathering of Food, Wood, Stone, Gold, and Gems, as well as Caravans from Ark of Osiris.
words.16: Cleanse effects from active skills can be prevented by the Silenced effect. Cleanse effects from passive skills can take effect no matter what.
words.17: This effect cannot be dispelled by other troops.
words.20: Normal buffs include buffs that increase the target troop's Attack, Defense, Health, healing received, etc.
words.22: Resets the Rage of this commander's troop, all temporary buffs and debuffs, and the amount of time it has been in combat.
words.25: Extra normal attacks do not trigger counterattacks. Can launch up to 1 extra normal attack per second.
words.26: Smite damage is affected by bonuses to normal damage instead of bonuses to skill damage.
words.50: Non-rallied/non-garrisoned troops on the map (excluding resource points).
words.51: Includes basic attack, counterattack, smite, and combo attack damage. Bonuses/reductions to normal damage do not affect ranged normal damage.
words.52: Includes direct damage and additional damage. Does not include ranged direct damage nor ranged additional damage.
words.53: Includes ranged basic attack, ranged counterattack, ranged smite, and ranged combo attack damage. Bonuses/reductions to ranged normal damage do not affect non-ranged normal damage.
words.54: Includes "ranged direct damage" and "ranged additional damage".
words.61: True damage calculation is not affected by the attacking troop's Attack attribute or the defending troop's Defense attribute.
words.62: For the duration of the effect, reduces an enemy's attributes and increases your own by an equal amount.
words.63: Pierce is triggered by Alp Arslan's Heroic Lion and Oghuz Archery skills.
words.64:
Tsar's Decree includes the following effects:
- Rampage: Deal 3% more normal damage.
- Furious Heart: Gain 5% Rage Gain Speed.
- Prescient: Take 5% less skill damage.
- Toughness: Take 3% less damage.
- Conquest: Has a 25% chance to gain an additional stack of Tsar's Authority whenever gaining Tsar's Authority. Cooldown: 3 seconds.
- Verdict: Launch an additional combo attack whenever launching basic attacks (Damage Factor 200). Cooldown: 5 seconds.
words.101: A skill's heal strength is equal to how many units it is capable of healing (not how many it actually healed when used), including any bonuses/reductions to healing.
words.1675: After triggering 2 times in a single second, every subsequent trigger that second deals 25% less damage than the last (down to a minimum of 25%).
words.15119: In addition to ignoring the attacking troop's Attack and the defending troop's Defense, fixed true damage calculation is also not affected by any buff or debuff effects.
